prompt: Which statement about Copilot cloud agent and pull request merging is accurate?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, Copilot cloud agent cannot mark its own PRs as Ready for review, approve, or merge them. Hard-coded, not configurable.

options.text: It can merge PRs if all checks pass
It can mark PRs Ready and merge if repo allows auto-merge
It cannot mark its own PRs as Ready, approve, or merge them — human review always required
It can merge after a 24-hour wait
